# Native build that produced the results in repro/results (native_build "v4" in repro/config/campaign.yaml),
# built on the paper's machine (Ubuntu 24.04, 2x AMD EPYC 7763) on 2026-10-31.
#
# This release branch differs from the source of that build only by removals that do not change
# the behaviour of any experiment configuration: unused test drivers and optimizer functions
# (optimize_qalm_adaptive, hadamard_reduction_cost), an optional pass-ending rule that was used only
# in pilot runs and was off in every reported run, and dead code and stale unit tests in roqc/.
## configure and build
cmake -S . -B build/repro4 -DRust_TOOLCHAIN=1.94.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -DPython_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/python3
RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.94.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu cmake --build build/repro4 --target test_greedy_k_ablation test_qalm test_original
## compile flags (quartz_runtime)
CXX_FLAGS = -O3 -Wall -fPIC -std=c++17  -fopenmp -O3 -DNDEBUG -fPIC
## toolchain
rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25)
cargo 1.94.1 (29ea6fb6a 2026-03-24)
gcc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0
cmake version 3.28.3
corrosion v0.5 (a1a1aaa057a5da656c06c3d8505b767a4e941709)
